basic_info.description: Enjoy modern living in this fully renovated airy, chic loft style city condo. Located in the vibrant SOMA/South Beach/Mission Bay intersection, the City's main tech corridor! Cool, industrial vibes - be wow'ed by soaring high ceilings, oversized floor to ceiling grand windows and exposed wood beams in the heart of the home. Be the 1st to experience brand-new upgrades to this urban sanctuary - new contemporary kitchen, two new modern bathrooms (one on each level), new floors and all new stainless steel appliances too! Open concept living/dining area. Private upstairs mezzanine level primary bedroom suite w/ bathroom. Second bedroom (or guest bedroom, office, den) located on the main level. In-unit stacked washer and dryer and 1 deeded parking space included. Additional perks include a lovely zen-like shared courtyard, bike storage room and building elevator. Effortless access to freeways 280, 101 and 80 and easy commute options via Caltrain and Muni. Close proximity to Oracle Park and Chase Center.
